The current low-level goals (LLGs) comprehensively cover the parent high-level goal (HLG) of 'Support accurate and timely product inventory management'. Each LLG is documentarily supported, non-redundant, and correctly scoped. They accurately represent the system's functional interactions for real-time inventory tracking, automatic reorder triggers, manual replenishment, and supplier communication.

The LLGs 'Administrator sets reorder threshold for product' (llg_001), 'System updates inventory in real-time upon product receipt' (llg_002), 'Administrator initiates manual replenishment for product' (llg_003), and 'System triggers automatic reorder when inventory reaches threshold' (llg_004) all directly support the parent HLG by detailing how inventory management is achieved through both automated and manual means. The LLG 'System sends automatic reorder request to supplier with 2-working-day confirmation deadline' (llg_005) ensures timely supplier communication, crucial for maintaining product availability.

No unsupported or misleading LLGs were identified, nor are there any essential capabilities missing from the decomposition. The system's responsibilities and scope are accurately represented without inventing UI interactions or requiring manual triggers where automatic effects suffice.

Decision: KEEP_LOW_LEVEL_GOALS
